---
title: "Lab 6: First Reproducible R Report"
---

## Goal

Create a short reproducible report with a question, code, plots, and interpretation.

## Tasks

1. Open <a href="../code/r/week06-first-report.qmd" download>week06-first-report.qmd</a>.
2. Render the report.
3. Replace one plot with a plot of your own.
4. Add a one-paragraph interpretation.
5. Add a short validation section.

## Deliverable

Submit the rendered HTML report and the source `.qmd` file.

## AI Use

You may ask an LLM for help improving the caption of one figure. You must check that the caption describes only what the plot supports.
